content: Implement routes for POST/DELETE /api/users/:id/sports with middleware chain and E2E flow
activeForm: Implementing routes for POST/DELETE /api/users/:id/sports with middleware chain and E2E flow
description: Implement route definitions for POST /api/users/:id/sports and DELETE /api/users/:id/sports/:sport endpoints with complete middleware chain (auth, validation, audit). Integrate controllers from T4.2 with proper request/response flow. Write 4 MVP-tier tests (2 integration tests for middleware chain and status codes, 2 E2E tests for complete user flow). This subtask completes P2-PROF-T4 by wiring together repository, validation, controllers, and routes.

checkpoints.name: Route Definitions Complete
checkpoints.requirement: POST and DELETE routes defined with middleware chain (auth, validation, audit)

checkpoints.name: Integration and E2E Tests Passing
checkpoints.requirement: Route integration complete with all 4 tests passing (middleware chain and full user flow verified)

phases.name: Route Implementation
actions: Update: src/services/user-service/routes/user.routes.ts OR Create: user-sports.routes.ts
Decision: Add to existing user.routes.ts (recommended) or create separate file
Implement: POST /api/users/:id/sports route
Middleware: authenticateToken (JWT validation)
Middleware: validateRequest(addSportSchema) (payload validation)
Middleware: auditMiddleware (optional - log sport additions)
Handler: addUserSport controller from T4.2
Implement: DELETE /api/users/:id/sports/:sport route
Middleware: authenticateToken (JWT validation)
Middleware: auditMiddleware (optional - log sport removals)
Handler: removeUserSport controller from T4.2
Mount: Routes to Express app (app.use('/api/users', userRoutes))
phases.gate: Both routes must be defined with complete middleware chain before proceeding

phases.name: Middleware Chain Verification
actions: Verify: authenticateToken runs before controller (401 if no JWT)
Verify: validateRequest rejects invalid payloads (400 before controller)
Verify: Controller receives AuthenticatedRequest with user property
Verify: Audit middleware logs sport management actions (if implemented)
Verify: Error handling middleware catches controller errors
Verify: Proper status codes returned (201, 204, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409)

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (4 tests)
actions: Write: 2 integration tests for route middleware chain
Test: POST route - missing JWT returns 401
Test: POST route - invalid payload returns 400 (validation middleware)
Write: 2 E2E tests for complete user flow
Test: E2E - Login → POST pickleball → GET profile → Verify sport in array
Test: E2E - Login → POST paddle → DELETE paddle → GET profile → Verify removed
Verify: All 4 tests passing with complete request/response cycle
Verify: Integration with existing user profile GET endpoint (sports array populated)
